# Automation 策略（生成）

> 配置全显式（无 profile 运行时概念）；内置预设（manual/guarded/autonomous）仅为 `configctl init` 模板，见 `model/presets.yml`。决策矩阵直接引用配置显式能力标志。

## 事件决策（顺序判断，首中即返）
### STAGE_COMPLETED
| # | 条件 | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | not advance_stage | WAIT_NEXT_COMMAND |
| 2 | true | ADVANCE_WORKFLOW |

### TASK_DOD_PASSED
| # | 条件 | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | payload.complexity != SIMPLE | RUN_CR |
| 2 | not payload.simple_gate_valid | RUN_CR |
| 3 | simple_skip_cr | SKIP_CR |
| 4 | true | RUN_CR |

### PLAN_READY
| # | 条件 | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | not plan_auto_validate | WAIT_USER_APPROVAL |
| 2 | true | VALIDATE_PLAN |

### ACCEPTANCE_FAILED
| # | 条件 | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | payload.root_causes has DESIGN or payload.root_causes has REQUIREMENT | REQUEST_DESIGN_REWORK |
| 2 | payload.fix_attempts >= limits.acceptance_fix_max | WAIT_USER_APPROVAL |
| 3 | accept_auto_fix | FIX_ACCEPTANCE_ISSUES |
| 4 | true | WAIT_USER_APPROVAL |

### ACCEPTANCE_COMPLETED
| # | 条件 | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | advance_summary | GENERATE_SUMMARY |
| 2 | true | FINISH_ACCEPTANCE |

### CR_JUDGED
| # | 条件 | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | payload.uncertain_count > 0 | WAIT_USER_APPROVAL |
| 2 | payload.accepted_count > 0 and payload.min_confidence < quality.judge_min_confidence | WAIT_USER_APPROVAL |
| 3 | payload.has_design_rework | REQUEST_DESIGN_REWORK |
| 4 | payload.has_baseline_align and payload.accepted_count == 0 | WAIT_USER_APPROVAL |
| 5 | payload.accepted_count == 0 and cr_zero_auto_confirm | CONFIRM_CR |
| 6 | payload.accepted_count == 0 | WAIT_USER_APPROVAL |
| 7 | cr_minor_auto_fix | FIX_CR_ISSUES |
| 8 | true | WAIT_USER_APPROVAL |

### CR_RECHECKED
| # | 条件 | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | payload.regression_detected | AUTONOMOUS_BLOCK |
| 2 | payload.new_issue_count > 0 and payload.cr_round < limits.cr_fix_max | FIX_CR_ISSUES |
| 3 | payload.cr_round >= limits.cr_fix_max | AUTONOMOUS_BLOCK |
| 4 | true | CONFIRM_CR |

### REWRITE_COMPLETED
| # | 条件 | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | skip_recheck | CONFIRM_CR |
| 2 | payload.fixed_has_baseline_align | CR_RECHECK |
| 3 | payload.fixed_has_major | CR_RECHECK |
| 4 | minor_fix_auto_confirm and payload.quality_gate_evidence | CONFIRM_CR |
| 5 | true | CR_RECHECK |

### VERIFY_FAILED
| # | 条件 | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | skip_recheck | AUTONOMOUS_BLOCK |
| 2 | payload.is_fix_related and payload.cr_round < limits.cr_fix_max | CR_RECHECK |
| 3 | true | AUTONOMOUS_BLOCK |

## 固定安全规则（Profile 不能覆盖）
- **fs-1** CR_SCANNED 报告不完整（report_complete=false）不得推进；须补齐统一报告后重扫
- **fs-2** SIMPLE Gate 不完整/失败/存在风险信号必须 RUN_CR
- **fs-3** CR 存在 MAJOR 或 DESIGN 问题必须 WAIT_USER_APPROVAL
- **fs-4** 验收存在 DESIGN/REQUIREMENT 根因必须 REQUEST_DESIGN_REWORK
- **fs-5** 验收自动修复达到上限必须 WAIT_USER_APPROVAL
- **fs-6** 自动修复仅限 MINOR + IMPLEMENTATION 问题；MAJOR/DESIGN/REQUIREMENT/信息不完整必须人工或 rework
- **fs-7** plan 改变已批准契约（PLAN_APPROVED.contract_changed=true）必须重进设计人工门，不得自动继续编码
- **fs-8** CR 处置三档互斥：BASELINE_ALIGN 与 DESIGN_REWORK 不得同时成立；has_baseline_align=true 必须走修复/人工门，不得走零问题自动确认
